subject: ela
intro: On the SAT, these questions test subject-verb agreement (a verb must match its subject in number) and pronoun agreement (a pronoun must match its antecedent in number), even across interrupting phrases. Ignore the words between the subject and verb when checking agreement.

items.prompt: Choose the verb: 'The box of old photographs ______ on the shelf.' (sit / sits)
Why is 'photographs' NOT the subject there?

steps: 'Of old photographs' is an interrupting prepositional phrase.
So 'photographs' is just part of the interrupter.
solution.answer: 'Of old photographs' is an interrupting phrase; the subject is 'box.'

items.prompt: Choose the pronoun: 'Each of the students must bring ______ own pencil.' (their / his or her)

steps: 'Each' is singular, so a singular pronoun agrees.
On the SAT, 'his or her' agrees in number with 'each.'

items.prompt: A verb must agree with its subject in ____.
A pronoun must agree with its ____.
Ignore the interrupting ____ when checking agreement.
